text: Yes, forest clearing occurred on this property in 2021. About 81.3 hectares of tree cover were lost that year, primarily in a planted forest (Pinus species). The evidence is corroborated by multiple sources, confirming the loss. However, the cause (e.g., harvesting, fire) and legality of the clearing are not determined. No further clearing has been observed since 2021, as the latest data (2025) shows no additional losses. The property remains a planted forest.
